name: revenue-ops
description: The complete revenue operations plugin for Malaysian business owners — four AI skills covering lead research, inquiry qualification, proposal writing, and payment chasing.

plugins.name: lead-researcher
plugins.description: Finds target companies, surfaces contact intelligence, and builds a multi-touch outreach sequence. Two modes: research a specific company, or find target companies by industry and location.

plugins.name: inquiry-qualifier
plugins.description: Scores incoming leads, reads the psychology behind the message, and drafts a response that advances the sale. Works from WhatsApp messages, emails, web form submissions, or any text inquiry.

plugins.name: proposal-writer
plugins.description: Turns rough briefs into persuasive, client-ready proposals using the Problem → Consequence → Solution → Proof → Commitment formula. Works from voice notes, call notes, client emails, or verbal briefs.

plugins.name: payment-chaser
plugins.description: Diagnoses why an invoice is unpaid and drafts the right follow-up. Produces messages across 5 escalation levels with multi-channel sequences and special templates for disputes and ghost clients.
